# SEMRS Shops: marketplace export files

Generated from the SEMRS Shops catalogues (Tools → Shop exports in WordPress).

| File | For | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `shopify-digital.csv` | Shopify → Products → Import | 35 digital products, one row per variant, draft status, no shipping |
| `shopify-crochet.csv` | Shopify → Products → Import | 36 crochet patterns, one row per variant, draft status, no shipping |
| `etsy-digital.csv` | Etsy Shop Manager or a listing tool | 35 listings with 13 tags, variations, personalisation notes |
| `etsy-crochet.csv` | Etsy Shop Manager or a listing tool | 36 listings with 13 tags, variations |

Image URLs are blank in these copies. Export again from Tools → Shop exports on your public site to get working image URLs, or upload the images from `plugins/semrs-shops/images/`.

Prices are 2026 marketplace estimates (mostly Etsy keyword-tool medians). Check them against current listings before publishing.

eBay and Amazon files are not included: both marketplaces restrict downloadable products such as printables and patterns.
